description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order to prescribe that the Cost of the any Healthcare Service other than the fees paid to medical practitioners, medical consultation fees etc. be excluded in calculating the value for the purpose of VAT w.e.f. 01.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the Value Added Tax Act to prescribe specific tax treatment for healthcare services. It contains a legal order made by the Minister of Finance under statutory authority, amending how VAT calculations are performed for healthcare services. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (new regulations, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements) rather than government personnel or structural changes.
